name: DataBridge
tagline: AI agents that align schemas and merge data when two financial institutions combine.
problem: In mergers, financial systems use different schemas and context gets lost.
solution: Agents interpret schemas, align columns, resolve conflicts and check integrity, deployed on cloud-native infrastructure.
demo_moment: Team-described: feed two bank datasets and get one reconciled set.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Finance AI Eval” among 124 submissions.
Heavy infrastructure for a weekend: Kubernetes, CI and agent tooling.

lessons: Evaluation prizes reward a measurable pipeline.
